title: DEHP induces hepatic fibrosis through STAT3-SLC7A11-ROS axis.
authors: Liang, Siqin; Xu, Zhiliang; You, Xiaoxiang; Yuan, Tinghao; He, Jun; Mao, Lei; Jin, Anan; Zhou, Xinwen; Yi, Bo; Li, Ming; Tu, Qiang; Xu, Bin
one_liner_zh: 该文研究DEHP通过STAT3-SLC7A11-ROS轴诱导肝纤维化，仅涉及STAT3蛋白与DEHP小分子的分子对接，无蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Di-(2-ethylhexyl) phthalate (DEHP) is a pervasive environmental contaminant commonly found in daily life, and numerous studies have linked it to the progression of liver diseases and organ fibrosis. However, the precise molecular mechanisms by which DEHP induces liver fibrosis remain incompletely understood. This study aimed to investigate the effects of DEHP on liver fibrosis and its underlying mechanisms. We observed that 100 muM DEHP and 6 days of exposure significantly induced activated human hepatic stellate cells (HSCs) and upregulated the fibrosis marker alpha-smooth muscle actin (alpha-SMA). By integrating DEHP and liver fibrosis-related target information from various databases, followed by an assessment of the protein-protein interactome (PPI) network and corresponding functional pathway mapping, we predicted that DEHP-induced liver fibrosis is closely associated with the accumulation of reactive oxygen species (ROS). Molecular docking experiments revealed that DEHP spontaneously binds to STAT3, with GLU-638 identified as a critical amino acid residue for this interaction. Further functional experiments confirmed that DEHP promotes ROS accumulation by downregulating SLC7A11 expression, a process mediated by STAT3. In summary, DEHP facilitates intracellular ROS accumulation by mediating the STAT3-SLC7A11-ROS signaling axis, thereby triggering the formation of liver fibrosis. This research provides novel molecular targets and therapeutic strategies for the future prevention and treatment of liver fibrosis.
abstract_zh: 邻苯二甲酸二(2-乙基己基)酯（DEHP）是一种普遍存在的环境污染物，常见于日常生活中，众多研究已将其与肝脏疾病和器官纤维化的进展相关联。然而，DEHP诱导肝纤维化的确切分子机制仍未完全阐明。本研究旨在探讨DEHP对肝纤维化的影响及其潜在机制。我们观察到，100 μM DEHP暴露6天显著诱导了活化的人肝星状细胞（HSCs），并上调了纤维化标志物α-平滑肌肌动蛋白（alpha-SMA）。通过整合多个数据库中DEHP和肝纤维化相关的靶点信息，并评估蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPI）网络及相应的功能通路映射，我们预测DEHP诱导的肝纤维化与活性氧（ROS）的积累密切相关。分子对接实验揭示，DEHP自发结合STAT3，其中GLU-638被鉴定为该相互作用的关键氨基酸残基。进一步的功能实验证实，DEHP通过下调SLC7A11表达促进ROS积累，这一过程由STAT3介导。总之，DEHP通过介导STAT3-SLC7A11-ROS信号轴促进细胞内ROS积累，从而触发肝纤维化的形成。本研究为未来肝纤维化的预防和治疗提供了新的分子靶点和治疗策略。
